source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Rh system, block for block, with the Kitab ki ghalti box (PDF 94-95).

blocks.text: Rh system insanon ka doosra sab se ahem blood group system hai. Is ka naam (Rh) Rhesus bandar se liya gaya hai, jis mein is ka antigen sab se pehle Landsteiner ne daryaft kiya; kitab is ka zamana 1930s batati hai (aam taur par yeh daryaft 1940 mein Landsteiner aur Wiener se mansoob hai). Yeh system RBCs par Rh-antigen (jise Rh factor ya antigen-D bhi kehte hain) ke hone ya na hone par mabni hai. Jin logon mein yeh antigen ho woh Rh-positive, aur jin mein na ho woh Rh-negative kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: Do red blood cells. Bare cell, Rh-positive fard ka RBC, ki satah par chhote gol antigen-D nishan hain; doosra, Rh-negative fard ka RBC, in ke baghair hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.5: Rh blood group nizam (kitab ki Figure 18.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Antigen-D, RBC of Rh-positive individual, RBC of Rh-negative individual.

blocks.text: Aam taur par kisi ka blood group batate waqt ABO aur Rh dono systems saath bataye jate hain. Misaal: jis ke paas antigen-A aur Rh-antigen dono hon us ka blood group A-positive hai; jis ke paas antigen-A ho lekin Rh-antigen na ho us ka A-negative. B, AB aur O groups ke saath bhi yahi hai.
